draft.emotion: measured and deliberate, acknowledging a steady, unhurried pace
notes: Contrasts with 速い (はやい, fast in speed) and 早い (はやい, early in time).
For arriving behind schedule, Japanese usually uses the verb 遅れる (おくれる, to be late/delayed) rather than 遅い.
